idea: A FURTHER readability/navigation breakdown of .ralph-overview/data.json beyond the shipped hot/cold two-shard split (ralph-overview 2.12.0), without breaking the loader/watcher/MCP/viewer/projection consumers that all assemble one {tasks:[...]}.

candidateDirections.name: Generated lean read views + projection routing — canonical hot/cold storage unchanged
candidateDirections.summary: Keep hot/cold storage as-is; add a tracked-only + fully-body-stripped active-summary-tasks.json, strip kanbanCards in summary-projection.json, extend tasks/INDEX.md (per-scope), and route docs/skills/agents to read the lean projection+index first. Zero loader/watcher/data-edit change; attacks the real ~76%-body-bulk + discoverability problem.

candidateDirections.name: Body-sidecar extraction — move prompt/descriptionHtml (and maybe kanbanCards) bodies out of data.json, keep the task spine + lifecycle partition
candidateDirections.summary: If the canonical EDIT file itself must shrink: extract the measured 76% body bulk (command.prompts ~180KB + kanbanCards ~122KB) into SAME-DIR sibling sidecars hydrated by the loader before normalize, keeping the assembled {tasks:[...]} byte-equivalent and the lifecycle-based 2-shard move contract unchanged. Only pursue if D-001 proves insufficient; must keep sidecars same-dir (watcher invariant #14) and prove source-preserving data-edit round-trip.

candidateDirections.name: Per-scope or per-task subdirectory shards (literal seed options 1 & 2) — reject unless a flat, ordered, watcher-safe contract is proven first
candidateDirections.summary: The literal data/<scope>.json or data/tasks/<id>.json layout: all three lenses flag that a NEW subdirectory breaks the depth-0 same-dir watcher (invariant #14 -> Windows cold-start hang), needs a deterministic order-owner manifest or it churns snapshots/projections, and multiplies the crash-safe N-way move + seqlock cases. Gated behind a read-only byte-parity + watcher-smoke prototype; not the recommended first move.

questionsForSynthesis: What exact read op is painful: human editing of canonical rows, agent listing/triage, or agent loading full prompt bodies for execution? (D-001 vs D-002)
Why are agents still opening data.json when summary-projection.json + tasks/INDEX.md already exist? Skill/doc/tool-routing gap rather than a storage gap?
Should summary-projection.json also strip kanbanCards, and should a tracked-only + fully-stripped active-summary-tasks.json exist before ANY storage change?
If canonical editability is the real pain, can data-edit / overview MCP tools provide focused per-task views + body editors so humans rarely open the whole JSON?
If any further split is ever pursued: who owns task order, and can it be tested byte-identical against snapshot/projection output on the current ~307-task corpus?
